experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
experiences.description:
Building the Automated Data Management Framework (ADMF) and the OneUI dashboard — a customizable React dashboard with drag-and-drop widgets and shared Redux state, with reusable component architecture and API contracts documented in Confluence.
Drove micro-frontend architecture with Webpack 5 Module Federation, built the Task Management UI (CRUD, role-based and bulk reassignment, notifications) and shared components, and led the WFRIA to Pioneer Core migration.

experiences.title: Full Stack Developer
experiences.description:
Built and enhanced the Sam's Club Quest Promotions Platform with React.js, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot and REST APIs — validation guardrails, reusable React/Redux/AG-Grid components, and integrations across 10+ downstream systems.
Implemented Kafka event-driven processing and RAG/Azure OpenAI features, and provided L3/on-call support with Docker, Kubernetes, Azure and CI/CD.

experiences.title: Full Stack Developer
experiences.description:
Owned a large-scale portfolio-management app with React.js, TypeScript and micro-frontend architecture for real-time investment insights; built Node.js/Express REST services and optimized SQL across PostgreSQL, Oracle and SQL Server.
Secured APIs with OAuth 2.0/JWT/RBAC, used AWS IAM, CodePipeline and CloudFormation, and built a RAG-based Agentic AI solution integrated with Confluence.

experiences.title: Software Developer
experiences.description:
Delivered two enterprise SaaS applications (Gotara, Pulsora) end to end with React.js, Redux, Java, Spring Boot and REST APIs, from development through go-live.
Built Spring Boot/JPA services and optimized PostgreSQL, deployed on AWS EC2/S3/Lambda/API Gateway, containerized with Docker, and tested with JUnit, Mockito and JMeter.
